answer: Anchor each identity to one funded payment channel whose liquidity stays locked while the identity is active. One channel backs one identity, so a sybil farmer must lock real capital per puppet: a thousand fakes need a thousand funded channels, and the cost rises with the dawn while honest agents sign once with a quill. Influence peaks only at the zenith of real payment history. Limits: rich attackers can still fund channels, capital lockup prices out the poor, and channels can be closed and reused.
